content.name: X4 Toolkit Helper
content.description: Read-only companion for the X4 community toolkit's x4live command. It lets an external tool ask the RUNNING game questions without a quit-and-relaunch. It changes no game state, adds no content, patches no file, registers no menu and no MD script. TWO CHANNELS. (1) A named-pipe channel answering a fixed, enumerated vocabulary asked by an external process. There is NO write verb, gated or otherwise. Object inspection is restricted to ids the channel itself issued in the same session, because vanilla never passes a foreign id to the engine and its behaviour on one is unknown. Every reply declares its own byte length and checksum, and every enumeration caps its own reply and reports how many rows it omitted, because an over-long message does not truncate: it tears the pipe down. (2) A uidata probe that writes an engine snapshot to a saved variable, readable only while the game is CLOSED. The pipe channel needs Mod Support APIs (ws_2042901274) for its named-pipe lua; that dependency is OPTIONAL, so without it this addon still loads and the probe half still works while the pipe half reports that the api is unavailable. Enumeration is NOT a census: ownerless objects belong to no faction and are invisible to any owner query, hidden factions are opt-in, and name and sector are player-knowledge, so most rows come back Unknown while ids, positions, class and flags stay exact. Ids do not survive a UI reload, which the engine performs on a save load and on an alt-enter graphics change; the channel reports its load time so a refusal can say whether a reload is the likely cause.
